Jaleel's book had a choppy Friday, October 16. The brightest spots were Expand Energy (EXE, +2.87%), AutoZone (AZO, +1.99%), and Zoetis (ZTS, +1.22%), with S&P Global (SPGI, +1.14%) also adding modestly on a rotation into financials as Treasury yields retreated. Abbott (ABT, +0.20%) and Boston Scientific (BSX, +0.57%) were quiet but stable, though BSX's elevated risk flag and its October 28 earnings date mean that steadiness shouldn't be mistaken for safety. On the other side, Rocket Lab (RKLB) cratered -7.98% today — the headline linking it to a broader chip-stock losing streak and CoreWeave credit concerns is an odd fit for a launch company, but sentiment is what it is, and at -35.1% unrealized the position remains the book's deepest wound and is flagged AVOID. Broadcom (AVGO) slid -4.52% on rate-hike fears pressuring the chip complex, compounding a -12.8% unrealized loss. NVIDIA (NVDA) dropped -1.43% on the same macro narrative.

The drift worth watching is the cluster of STRONG BUY-rated names sitting on meaningful unrealized losses: BSX (-9.4%), AVGO (-12.8%), NBIX (-16.7%), LULU (-24.1%), and RKLB (-35.1%, AVOID). Thesis and price are clearly diverging on several of these — LULU faces a guidance cut, stalled China sales, and tariff pressure on margins, while RKLB carries no quality rating to speak of (QARP 36.6). Adobe (ADBE) finished essentially flat on the year and slipped -2.57% today despite a sector rotation headline that should have helped it; the AI-narrative overhang is still winning that tug-of-war.

Heading into Monday, October 19, the key focus should be BSX (earnings October 28) and ABT (earnings October 21). Both are top-three weights and carry active risk flags. The rate-hike narrative that hammered NVDA and AVGO today bears watching — if that tone holds Monday, the semiconductor sleeve will face more pressure. RKLB needs a clear-eyed reassessment; the AVOID verdict and a -35.1% hole in a capital-preservation book are hard to reconcile.

attention.headline: AVOID-rated, -35.1% unrealized, dropped another -7.98% today
attention.note: A position rated AVOID with a QARP of 36.6 and a -35.1% unrealized loss has no natural home in a capital-preservation book; today's -7.98% move sharpens the urgency for a hold-or-exit decision before further erosion.

attention.headline: Earnings October 28 with an elevated guidance-cut risk flag still live
attention.note: BSX is the third-largest weight, carries an elevated risk flag (FY26 growth guidance slashed, management guiding flat through Q3), and reports in 12 days — a clear decision point on sizing before that binary event.

attention.headline: Earnings October 21 — EPS outlook already trimmed
attention.note: Abbott is the second-largest weight and reports Tuesday; the FY EPS guide was already cut on deal financing and a weak flu season, so any further downside surprise could move a meaningful slice of the book.

attention.headline: -4.52% today, -12.8% unrealized, chip-rate narrative accelerating
attention.note: Broadcom dropped sharply on rate-hike fears hitting capex-heavy chip customers; with the loss deepening and the same macro headwind pressuring NVDA simultaneously, the combined semiconductor exposure deserves a fresh look if the Fed tone stays hawkish into Monday.
